documents.text: Atlas project deployment region is Dublin. Release identifier ATLAS-R17.

Cedar incident owner is Mira. Escalation channel is cedar-ops.
Delta documentation is licensed under MIT. The docs build command is make docs.
Elm queue retention is seven days. Expired jobs are purged daily.
Fir service health endpoint is /ready. The service listens on port 9157.
Grove UI theme is amber. Its keyboard shortcut for search is Ctrl K.
